name: git
description: Git MCP server for MammothOS. Exposes safe git operations (status, diff, log, branch) to Mammoth Mind so it can understand the repo state. Commit and push require explicit operator approval.
notes: Read-only tools (status, diff, log) run without approval.
Mutation tools (add, commit, push, checkout, reset) require human_gate approval before execution.
Install with: pip install uvx  or  pipx install mcp-server-git
